prompt: Write a method that fills a template by replacing every {name} placeholder with a value. Complete the fillTemplate method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: The key insight is to first build the exact text being searched for -- "{" + name + "}" -- and then use String.replace, which substitutes EVERY occurrence of a literal target. Note the difference from replaceAll, which treats its first argument as a regular expression; curly braces are regex metacharacters, so replace (the literal version) is the right tool here. Because only the exact placeholder matches, {b} survives when filling {a}.
hints: First build the placeholder string: "{" + name + "}".
String.replace(target, value) replaces every occurrence of a LITERAL target -- no loop needed.
Avoid replaceAll here: it treats its argument as a regex, and { has special meaning in regexes.
